newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ABB 1996 net 148 percent higher.
newsitem.headline: India's ABB 1996 net 148 percent higher.

text.p: Electrical equipment maker Asea Brown Boveri said on Friday its net profit in calendar 1996 jumped 147.7 percent to 1.55 billion rupees against 625.3 million in the previous year.
ABB said in a statement its total income in 1996 climbed to 11.86 billion rupees, from 9.19 billion in 1995.
It said earnings per share worked out to 26.6 rupees on an equity capital of 311 million, against the previous year's figure of 20.1 rupees.
"The profit before taxation amounted to 2,034 million rupees (including profit on sale of the transportation business during the year of 806 million)," ABB said.
ABB set a total dividend of eight rupees a share for the year.
"For the year 1996, ABB's contribution to the exchequer in terms of duties and taxes (income tax, excise duties and sales tax) was about 1,770 million," the firm said.
ABB said taxes and duties in the previous year totalled 1,280 million rupees.
